tests.name: catalog_contract
tests.details: 64 unique rows; eight allowed slots with eight rows each; every slot covers all six moments; field types, lengths, enums, JSON, sources and declared conflict IDs checked

tests.name: sql_first_ingestion
tests.details: Exact eight-column schema, every field matches canonical JSON, and integrity_check=ok

tests.name: sql_repeat_ingestion
tests.details: All 64 rows and the complete content fingerprint remain identical

tests.name: unrelated_row_preserved
tests.details: A preexisting row from another archetype survives seed ingestion byte-for-byte

details.checks: IDs, moment binding, required actor/target bindings, half-open frame intervals, required slot coverage, same-actor/global duplicate slots, unresolved named placeholders, and declared overlapping conflicts

tests.name: readonly_database
tests.details: Eight-column schema, complete canonical content, and integrity_check=ok; no database writes

limits: These checks validate data, SQL behavior, declared composition rules, and optional database integrity. They do not prove anatomy, motion, rendering quality, or source truth.
Conflict checks use authored conflict IDs, overlapping half-open frame intervals, and actor/target identities; camera and environment slots are treated as global within each example.
The checker does not infer undeclared semantic conflicts or prove that compiled prose perfectly preserves every selected directive.
